content: OTel context propagates via W3C Trace Context injected into Kafka record headers (key-value headers supported since Kafka 0.11). Producer injects traceparent into headers on publish; consumer extracts and starts child span, giving one trace across produce/consume. franz-go exposes all record headers directly so otel propagator Inject/Extract can be wired manually around kgo.Record.Headers (no first-party franz-go otel plugin verified).
